name: Sea breeze
notes: Wind model #10: 11-16 kn, oscillation +/-5 deg with a period of about 120 s, a persistent trend of 5-15 deg one way, building up to 15 %; regular, mild (+20 %) puffs, few lulls.
Units: knots, degrees, seconds, metres; gains, losses, shares, coverage, build and drift as fractions.

The trend is the net shift over overSeconds, the 16-minute time limit; the build is the total rise in strength over the race as a fraction of base strength. The race seed picks neither: the keyed wind does (ADR 0001).

Placeholders (JSON Pointers above) await tuning: the 110-130 s period range (#10 says about 120 s), the trend's 960 s span, the build's 0 minimum (#10 says only up to 15 %), and the puff columns, set from #10's words (regular, mild, few lulls) and its shared ranges (60-150 m, puffs +20-35 %, lulls -15-25 %, fan up to 8 deg, drift 0.3-0.5 x wind).
